changes.title: Preview walk
items: Out of bed or off a dressing station, the witch steps as she walks straight away, instead of sliding about on her standing frame until her whole look has drawn

changes.title: Bubbles fade
items: Animals' speech and thought bubbles fade in as you come near and out as you leave, and don't show from the treetops or the treehouse

changes.title: Settings page
items: A Settings page (for now from the pause page's "Show settings page" button): change any key or pad button (two each; a key another action has asks Swap, Use both or Cancel), master, music, effects and voices volumes, mute when away, fullscreen and which screen (Chrome and Edge), quality, screen shake, reduce flashing, Talk held or toggled, text size, and your pad's button names (PlayStation or Xbox); by pad, keyboard or mouse, saved as you change them
